# Urban Mistrii Studio

> Urban Mistrii Studio is a Delhi-based architecture and interior design practice led by architect Ritika Rakhiani. The studio designs residences, farmhouses, restaurants, bars, hospitality spaces, workplaces, retail environments, installations, and development-led projects for clients across India and worldwide.

The full text of every public page is in one file: https://urbanmistrii.com/llms-full.txt

## Canonical identity

- Name: Urban Mistrii Studio
- Alternate name: UrbanMistrii
- Website: https://urbanmistrii.com/
- Founded: 2018
- Founder and studio lead: Ritika Rakhiani
- Founder profile: https://urbanmistrii.com/ritika-rakhiani
- Base: Saket, New Delhi, India
- Area served: India (including Delhi NCR) and worldwide
- Email: mail@urbanmistrii.com
- Phone: +91 99536 68560

## Services

- Architecture: concept design, planning, built form, facade language, drawing development, and site-responsive spatial strategy.
- Interior design: residential, hospitality, workplace, and retail interiors, including layouts, finishes, furniture, lighting, and detailing.
- Hospitality design: restaurants, bars, cafes, and guest-focused spaces shaped around atmosphere, operations, flow, and memory.
- Restaurant architecture and design: a focused page for clients looking to hire restaurant architects in Delhi.
- Retail interior design: store planning, product display, customer movement, branded environments, and execution support.
- Commercial interior design: workplaces, offices, client-facing environments, services coordination, and fit-out delivery.
- Group housing architecture: feasibility, site strategy, massing, unit mix, shared spaces, and residential development coordination.
- Execution support: finish schedules, design-intent reviews, vendor coordination, and site-stage decisions.

## Selected projects

- The Pool House, Chhatarpur, Delhi: a prefabricated farmhouse extension and residential retreat.
- Padmanabham, Janpath, New Delhi: a Chettinad-influenced South Indian restaurant interior.
- Ivory House: residential interior design.
- MAD: hospitality and experience design.
- Bar Bar, Varanasi: a rooftop bar redesign shaped by blue ombre walls, metal arches, flexible seating, and references to the Ganga.
- SEOUL, New Delhi: a 1,850 sq ft Korean restaurant designed around communal dining, durable materials, extraction, seating capacity, and culturally rooted gathering.
- Clinque / T-Groove, Noida: a microbrewery and restro-bar designed as a transition from tropical outdoor dining to a more theatrical interior.
- Metro Infrasys: workplace and commercial interior design.
- The Hill House, Shimla: a built 2019 private-house renovation focused on daylight, ventilation, adaptive planning, and neo-gothic character.
- Mahagun Residence: residential interior design focused on shared living, material balance, and everyday comfort.

## Quick answers

- Who are Urban Mistrii Studio? An architecture and interior design studio in Saket, New Delhi, founded in 2018 and led by architect Ritika Rakhiani.
- What do they design? Restaurants, bars and cafés; homes, villas and farmhouses; workplaces and offices; retail stores; clinics; and group housing.
- Where do they work? Delhi NCR (New Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida), elsewhere in India (Varanasi, Shimla, Chennai, Goa) and for clients abroad.
- What is their approach? Spaces are planned around how people gather, live and work, and the studio stays involved on site so the built result matches the design.
- Studio line: "Good spaces don't happen by chance. They are thought through, down to the last detail."
- How to start a project: https://urbanmistrii.com/start-project, mail@urbanmistrii.com or +91 99536 68560.
